timeline.summary: Paradeep Phosphates announced postal ballot voting results approving directorial appointments with high public institutional dissent on specific resolutions.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,701.97 Cr (+34.6% YoY), net profit ₹155.6 Cr (-2.8% YoY).
Paradeep Phosphates released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation highlighting a 28.7% YoY surge in full-year revenue to ₹21,826.3 Cr and PAT of ₹1,000.8 Cr.
Paradeep Phosphates Limited uploaded the audio recording of its May 13, 2026, conference call with analysts and investors on its website.
On May 19, 2026, Paradeep Phosphates disclosed that NCLAT rejected its appeal for entry tax exemption under a BIFR scheme in Odisha.
On May 20, 2026, the Income Tax Authority passed an order quashing a ₹20.61 Cr tax demand for AY 2020-21 and granting a ₹20.57 Cr refund.
Shradha Agarwala, via V Venugopalan, declared no new encumbrances on Paradeep Phosphates shares under SEBI’s Reg 31(4) for FY2026.
Adventz Finance Private Limited, acting with concert parties, disclosed no new encumbrances on Paradeep Phosphates Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
ZUARI AGRO CHEMICALS LIMITED’s promoters, including persons acting in concert, declared no new encumbrances on Paradeep Phosphates Limited shares by 31-Mar-2026.

Zuari Maroc Phosphates Private Limited, acting in concert with Paradeep Phosphates Limited’s promoter Sachin Shankar Patil, declared no new encumbrances on shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Paradeep Phosphates signed an MoU with the Government of Odisha to invest ₹4,750 Cr in new chemical and fertilizer facilities.
